🎥🎬: Misty Green (2026)

Misty Green was once a successful, Emmy-winning actress whose Hollywood breakthrough promised a bright future. But years of personal struggles, destructive decisions and a declining career have left her struggling to make ends meet. When she is forced out of her deceased boyfriend’s home, Misty suddenly has just seven days to find somewhere to live and get her life back on track.

Desperate for a comeback, she reconnects with people from her Hollywood past, including a former talent agent and a renowned filmmaker who could offer her another opportunity. However, her journey is complicated by humiliating auditions, industry exploitation and the arrival of her troubled brother Jay, whose personal struggles add another layer of pressure to her already chaotic life.

source_details.synopsis: Misty Green is a 2026 American comedy-drama film written and directed by Chris Rock. Starring Rosalind Eleazar, Adam Driver, Daniel Kaluuya, Anna Kendrick, Topher Grace, and Chris Rock, it follows a fading award-winning actress who revisits her past and plans to make a comeback while reconnecting with her former talent agent. The film had its world premiere at the 2026 Toronto International Film Festival on September 12. It was theatrically released in the United States by A24 on October 9, 2026 and received mixed reviews from critics.
